serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
After some months… {{wi}} maybe years...
???1: Ugh! Goddammit!
???2: What happened? 
???1: This fucker’s catheter fell off again. He spoiled the whole bed!
???2: It’s not his fault, ok? Calm down. What if he hears you?
???1: Really? How can a comatose patient hear me? Don’t be such a fragile girl. 
???1: I could punch him in the dick and he wouldn’t feel a thing.
???2: …
???1: Besides… I heard that we are getting rid of this one.
???2: What do you mean?
???1: His mother used to pay for keeping him alive, but checks stopped coming. This little old lady was here to visit every day, but I haven’t seen her in a month or two.
???1: Probably kicked a bucket or something.
???2: This is so sad…
